en: Black‑and‑white photograph showing the interior of a Gothic church or cathedral. The view focuses on tall pointed arches, clustered stone columns with carved capitals, ribbed vaults, wooden pews in the foreground, a pulpit or confessional, and an elevated choir area with decorative wooden screens and tracery. On the right side there are sculpted stone doorways and wall plaques. The image has the look of an old printed postcard with a white border and slightly deckled edge.
